previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was admitted for his third maintenance cycle of high-dose methotrexate following reinduction therapy for CNS lymphoma, marking his seventh cycle since relapse. The chemotherapy infusion was administered without complications, and he developed only mild, expected elevations in liver enzymes. Constipation, a recurring issue during treatment, was managed with magnesium citrate. A brain MRI showed stable disease with no new enhancing lesions, allowing for an extension of treatment intervals to every other month. Aspirin and omeprazole were held during hospitalization and restarted at discharge. He was discharged home in stable condition with a plan for ongoing outpatient follow-up.
